name: Tamang Heritage Trail
alt_names: Tamang Heritage Trail and Langtang Trek (combined variant)
sub_region: Rasuwa District (Gosaikunda Rural Municipality; Gatlang, Tatopani, Thuman, Timure, Briddim), Bagmati Province

difficulty.notes: Low-to-mid altitude cultural trek; highest sleep approx. 2,600 m (Tatopani), highest point the Nagthali viewpoint (approx. 3,165-3,240 m). Daily walks of about 4-7 hours. Some operators grade it easy-to-moderate. [s4, s5, s6]

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu to Kathmandu by road, loop from Syabrubesi
duration_days.notes: Core walking loop is 5-6 days. Shorter 7-day versions go Nagthali - Briddim directly (skipping Timure); longer versions add Timure/Rasuwagadhi and a rest day in Briddim. Commonly combined with the Langtang Valley (Briddim - Lama Hotel/Langtang) for 12-15 days. [s4, s5, s6, s7]

itinerary.notes: 7-9 hours. Syabrubesi altitude given as 1,460-1,550 m. Syabrubesi was heavily damaged by the 26 Aug 2026 flood. [s4, s6, s9]
Large Tamang village; homestays; Parvati Kunda lake nearby. [s4, s5, s6]
Nagthali viewpoint over Langtang, Ganesh Himal and towards Tibet. Thuman lies in the restricted zone (Gosaikunda RM ward 1). [s5, s6, s8]

itinerary.route: Thuman - Timure (old Tibet trade route, near Rasuwagadhi)
itinerary.notes: Timure/Rasuwagadhi altitude given as 1,762-1,814 m; restricted zone. [s5, s6]

best_seasons.notes: After the 26 Aug 2026 Bhote Koshi flood destroyed much of Syabrubesi and the Syabrubesi - Rasuwagadhi road, an operator listed the Tamang Heritage Trail status as 'not confirmed' (18 Oct 2026). [s9, s10]

permits.name: Langtang National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued e-TIMS)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Tamang Heritage Trek is on NTB's mandatory guide + TIMS list

permits.name: Restricted Area Permit - Rasuwa, Gosaikunda Rural Municipality (all of ward 1 and part of ward 2; Thuman and Timure)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals entering Thuman/Timure; Department of Immigration via registered agency

guide_requirements: Licensed trekking guide and agency-issued TIMS card required (NTB lists Tamang Heritage Trek under the 31 March 2023 provision). The Thuman/Timure section is a restricted area: permit via a registered agency with a licensed guide; since 22 March 2026 solo trekkers may obtain restricted-area permits, max seven trekkers per guide. [s2, s3, s11]

drives: Kathmandu - Trishuli - Betrawati - Dhunche - Syabrubesi: approx. 7-9 hours (Betrawati Bailey bridge reopened 11 Oct 2026)
logistics.notes: Community homestays (e.g. Gatlang, Briddim) and simple lodges. [s4, s5]

highlights: Tamang culture, homestays and cultural performances in Gatlang and Briddim
Nagthali viewpoint over Langtang, Ganesh Himal and Tibetan ranges
Historic Rasuwagadhi fort and old Nepal-Tibet trade route near Timure
Low altitude - suitable for families and first-time trekkers
risks: Flood damage around Syabrubesi and the Rasuwagadhi road (Aug 2026)
Restricted-area permit needed for Thuman/Timure - checks can occur

acclimatization.notes: No acclimatization day needed; highest sleep approx. 2,600 m. [s7]

unverified: Current trail condition after the Aug 2026 flood (operator listed it as not confirmed).
Altitudes vary slightly between sources (Gatlang 2,238-2,290 m; Nagthali 3,165-3,240 m; Timure 1,762-1,814 m).
One operator says the restricted-area permit is not actively checked at every point; enforcement level is unconfirmed.
